subject.title: feat(whatsapp): per-group allowFrom for sender authorization

question: Should OpenClaw adopt per-group WhatsApp sender authorization as a supported public configuration contract once every inbound authorization and visibility consumer shares the same per-conversation resolution rule?
rationale: This PR adds a new security-sensitive configuration surface; the mechanical propagation repair is clear, but the long-term override, empty-list, and account-inheritance contract requires maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor the unified per-group contract
options.body: Accept the additive feature after the resolver is applied consistently to ingress, commands, and context visibility, with focused tests and upgrade-safe documentation.

options.title: Defer to account-policy centralization
options.body: Pause this branch and incorporate the feature only after the canonical WhatsApp account-policy seam is agreed and landed.

options.title: Decline the config surface
options.body: Keep account-level sender authorization as the supported contract and close the linked feature request with rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the unified per-group contract
recommendation.body: Accept the additive feature after the resolver is applied consistently to ingress, commands, and context visibility, with focused tests and upgrade-safe documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related WhatsApp account-policy work is the closest identified ownership seam for deciding whether this rule becomes a canonical shared policy.
